description: Write whole canonical project files (docs/00-requirement.md, docs/01-selection.json, board/netlist.json, design/constraints.json, src/main.ino, iterx.json…) as ONE atomic IterxAI project transaction — same entry schema, pre-processing and validation as the desktop AI write_project_files. Never write these files any other way. .json content may be an object. ok with warnings = written; error = nothing written (fix error.details and resubmit the whole batch). Runs in the desktop app when it is open (bridge feature project.mutate), otherwise headless in the IterxAI runtime.

files.description: [{path, content}] — project-relative path; content is the full text (or a JSON object for .json files). 0–32 entries.

pin_assignment.description: Optional: solve pins on constraints already on disk (files=[]), joint routing or optimistic versions; usually omitted (the host solves pins automatically).

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the IterxAI project directory (contains iterx.json). Defaults to the server cwd.

requestId.description: Idempotency key: same id + same payload replays the same result.

name: write_project_files
